syllabus_title: WAEC SSCE Chemistry Syllabus - Detailed Content

subtopics.title: Measurement of physical quantities and scientific measurements
subtopics.notes: Measurement of mass, length, time, temperature, volume; SI units, significant figures, precision and accuracy.

subtopics.title: Scientific Methods
subtopics.notes: Observation, hypothesis, experimentation, formulation of laws and theories.

subtopics.title: Gross features of the atom
subtopics.notes: Dalton’s atomic theory and limitations, J.J. Thomson’s experiment, Bohr’s model, Rutherford’s alpha scattering.

subtopics.title: Atomic number, isotopes, relative atomic/molecular mass
subtopics.notes: Proton number, neutrons, mass number, isotopes; calculations (e.g., chlorine); Carbon-12 scale.

subtopics.title: Particulate nature of matter
subtopics.notes: Atoms, molecules, ions; physical and chemical changes.

subtopics.title: Electron configuration
subtopics.notes: s, p, d orbitals for first 30 elements; Aufbau, Hund’s, Pauli principles; shapes of s and p orbitals.

subtopics.title: Periodicity and categories of elements
subtopics.notes: Electron configurations, metals, non-metals, semi-metals, groups.

subtopics.title: Periodic law and trends
subtopics.notes: Atomic/ionic size, ionization energy, electron affinity, electronegativity; third period gradation (Na-Ar).

subtopics.title: Halogens (Group VII)
subtopics.notes: Physical states, oxidation states, displacement reactions, reactions with water/alkali.

subtopics.title: First transition series (Sc-Zn)
subtopics.notes: Electron config, properties, reactivity, coloured compounds, catalysis, etc.

subtopics.title: Interatomic bonding - Ionic
subtopics.notes: Formation, properties, Lewis structures, factors (ionization energy, etc.).

subtopics.title: Intermolecular forces
subtopics.notes: van der Waals, hydrogen bonding, comparisons.

subtopics.title: Symbols, formulae, equations, laws of chemical combination
subtopics.notes: Empirical/molecular formulae, balancing, conservation of mass, etc.

subtopics.title: Kinetic theory, changes of state, diffusion
Gases
subtopics.notes: Gas laws (Boyle, Charles, etc.), ideal gas equation, preparations (H2, NH3, CO2).

subtopics.title: General principles and applications
subtopics.notes: Saturated solutions, curves, calculations, qualitative analysis.

subtopics.title: Oxidation/reduction, agents, equations, electrochemical cells
subtopics.notes: Electrode potentials, electrolysis, Faraday’s laws, corrosion.

subtopics.title: Classification, functional groups, purification, petroleum, homologous series, isomerism
Alkanes, alkenes, alkynes, benzene, alkanols, alkanoic acids, alkanoates
Proteins, amino acids, fats/oils, carbohydrates, synthetic polymers

topics.title: Nuclear chemistry, advanced periodic chemistry, hybridization, Hess’s law, buffers, etc.
topics.notes: Includes mass spectrometer, radioactivity, complex compounds, bond energy calculations, solubility product, rate laws, etc.

topics.title: NON-METALS AND THEIR COMPOUNDS
topics.notes: Carbon allotropes, coal, oxides of carbon, oxygen, hydrogen, water, halogens, etc.
